facts.business: Panacea Biotec Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and marketing of pharmaceutical formulations and vaccines.

auditor.name: M/s Suresh Surana & Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has incurred losses (including other comprehensive income) amounting to ₹287.60 million for the year ended March 31, 2026, and the retained earnings are negative to the extent of ₹2,178.43 million as on March 31, 2026. These conditions indicate that a material uncertainty exists that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses and negative retained earnings
Revenue recognition risk due to judgment in timing of transfer of control across various geographies and Incoterms
Impairment risk of property, plant and equipment
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include purchase/sale of goods and materials, rent expense/income, interest income/expense, and reimbursement/recovery of expenses with wholly owned subsidiaries (PBPL, PBS, PBGG, Panacea Biotec Inc., Meyten Realtech Private Limited), associates/joint ventures (Adveta Power Private Limited, PanEra Biotec Private Limited), and enterprises over which KMPs or their relatives have significant influence (EverWise Ventures LLP, First Lucre Partnership Co., MD Next Life Sciences LLP, Neophar Alipro Limited, MR Lex Corp LLP). Key management personnel remuneration and transactions with relatives of KMPs are also disclosed.
